name: Beata Szydło - § 15 - Am 8
title: REPORT on the security of energy supply in the EU
part_text: 15. Underlines that enhancing energy security requires a holistic approach, notably by boosting investment in research and development, and ensuring meaningful citizen participation, all of which are essential to achieving a resilient, sustainable and inclusive energy system; affirms that energy efficiency can play a role in, but cannot constitute the main pillar, of the EU’s energy policy; calls, in this regard, on the Commission to repeal the Energy Performance of Buildings Directive, as it will entail significant costs for Member States and households without delivering appreciable benefits;
